system.description:
Elves learn their history and that of many others in mnemonic songs.

Obstacles: Events of the current age, Ob 1; of the Third Age, Ob 2; of the Second Age, Ob 3; First Age, Ob 4; of the Years of the Sun, Ob 5; of the Creation and before time, Ob 6.

FoRKs: Any appropriate history or Wise skill or song

Skill Type: Academic. Tools: No.

Restrictions: Elves only

Root: Perception (§ magical skill: tests are open-ended)

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 259
